answer: Two established identities cross-sign a new one, and its payout becomes a stream over 100 epochs instead of a lump. Budget it in hours: a sysadmin spends 2 hours verifying a recruit and earns 1 percent of that recruit's stream per epoch. A farmer needs 2 real signers per fake, so 200 accounts cost 400 signatures nobody will give. A river of clones stalls at the first missing signature. The garden grows slow, and pigment fades if the stream is never claimed.
